metadata.title: AI debt financing to hit $1 trillion in 2027, Goldman Sachs says - MarketWatch

content.text:
13 hours ago
AI debt financing to hit $1 trillion in 2027, Goldman Sachs says
What AI slowdown?
Goldman Sachs said on Wednesday that next year will see nearly $1 trillion in new debt to help finance the artificial-intelligence buildout.
Here's the breakdown: About $440 billion globally from the market's five big hyperscalers and another $545 billion in project financing.
